hero.title: Renew your Working Holiday Visa
hero.subtitle: Upload your payslip or employer letter. The AI extracts all necessary information and guides you step by step to complete your application on the Australian government website.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Simple, fast and secure. Your visa in 3 steps.

step1.title: Upload your documents
step1.description: Payslip and/or employer letter. Accepted formats: PDF, JPG, PNG, WEBP (max 10 MB).

step2.title: Pay securely
step2.description: One-time payment of €29 via Stripe. Your payment data is protected. No subscription.

step3.title: Receive your personalized guide
step3.description: The AI extracts all your information and guides you field by field to complete your visa application.

pricing.title: Single transparent price
pricing.guarantee: Secure payment via Stripe · No refunds for completed analyses

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: You can upload your payslip and/or employer letter. PDF, JPG, PNG and WEBP formats are accepted up to 10 MB each.
faq.a2: No. Your files are processed in memory only and are never saved on our servers. Only the analysis result (extracted text) is retained.
faq.a3: Completed analyses are non-refundable. If the analysis failed for a technical reason, contact us.
faq.a4: The analysis usually takes less than 60 seconds after payment confirmation.
faq.a5: The guide is based on official information from immi.homeaffairs.gov.au. We provide direct links to official Australian government forms.
